title: 震撼，OpenAI全面开源Codex Harness
content: OpenAI open-sourced Codex Harness, the core framework powering its AI agents, under Apache-2.0 license. Harness manages task execution, memory, tool calling, human approvals, and error handling—enabling developers to embed AI directly into existing business applications rather than forcing workflows into generic chat interfaces. OpenAI demonstrated that optimized harness design improved GPT-5.6's ARC-AGI-3 score from 13.3% to 38.3% while reducing token output sixfold. The release includes three components: CLI tool codex exec, official SDKs for TypeScript/Python, and Codex app-server for product integration. Early adopters include Thrive Holdings (tax preparation, 7,000 filings processed, ~33% time reduction) and Cisco (cloud platform app builder).

title: 零基础速通DeepSeek Harness，带你玩转赛博乐高
content: DeepSeek Harness is an AI agent framework requiring command-line installation. It features workspace-based project management, multi-turn task execution with approval checkpoints, and a "trajectory" page showing tool calls and token usage. Its plugin system, powered by the Cordis kernel, allows extensive UI customization and functional extensions. A recent update added multimodal input support to commands like /goal and /plan, though actual image processing depends on the underlying model's capabilities. Launching the article's featured UI plugin required approximately 15 minutes using brute-force prompt Iteration. Uninstallation varies by installation method but can also be delegated to AI agents.

title: 我国首个相关客服国标 9 月出手规范：整治 AI 客服答非所问、找不到人工客服
content: China's first national standard governing the coordination between human and AI customer service takes effect September 1. The voluntary guideline clarifies service scope for each channel, mandates clear human agent access points, scientific task division, and automatic escalation to human representatives when conditions are met. Though not legally binding, it serves as an industry benchmark to improve service quality. Businesses favor AI customer service because it reduces costs by over 70 percent; some exploit AI to exhaust consumer patience and increase withdrawal rates.
